_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in Hope with a documented coil (0% 30d, flat funding, VIX 16.7); base rate favors HOLD until momentum or fear_greed actually breaks the stated bands.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly HOLD/Hope; narrative bearish on the print but does not force a rung change, so consensus stays HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains range-bound, 30d momentum holds 40-60, fear_greed stays ~55-72
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum <35 and fear_greed <50 with persistent exchange inflows (down to Disbelief), or momentum >70 with positive funding and CVD recovery (up to Optimism)
